description: The Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie of Burkina Faso published a 314-page volume of statistical tables from the fifth General Population and Housing Census, held in 2019. Its chapter on households and dwellings describes dwellings by type, rooms, occupancy status and construction material, and households by source of drinking water, mode of lighting, main energy for cooking, type of toilet, disposal of household waste and of wastewater, together with ownership of equipment, mobile phones, means of transport and internet access. Most service tables are given by urban and rural area, type of locality and region, and by sex and age of the household head. The census page also offers a sociodemographic atlas and thematic analyses, one of them on spatial disparities in housing quality, and links an open data portal of census indicators and a microdata catalogue. Format and access: free PDF downloads. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: tables are in PDF and mostly percentages, the finest level in the tables is the region, and round 1 could not reach the site from the cloud. Simulation uses: regional access to water, electricity or other lighting, cooking fuel, sanitation and waste services for planning and vulnerability models. Related records: IPUMS International and the WorldPop population grid.
